messages.subject: Bootstrap Estimate
parts:
Hi Lavaan Users,
                          I am facing problems while trying to get Bootstrap S.E. I have continuous longitudinal data in which subjects are measured at 6 occasions. I am building  the model starting with unconditional models and then adding all the predictors once unconditional model is selected. I am eliminating  the predictors one by on which are not significant contributor. Everything is running fine till the time I opted for bootstrap S.E. All S.E. are zero. Herebelow I am pasting the command and selected results. Kindly give  suggestion why it is happening and what to do?  


  Model.1<- ' 
          # INTERCEPT AND SLOPE EQUATIONS
          i=~1*Neuro1+1*Neuro2+1*Neuro3+1*Neuro4+1*Neuro5+1*Neuro6
          s1=~0*Neuro1+1*Neuro2+2*Neuro3+3*Neuro4+4*Neuro5+5*Neuro6
          s2=~0*Neuro1+1*Neuro2+4*Neuro3+9*Neuro4+16*Neuro5+25*Neuro6

       # REGRESSSION EQUATION OF FACTORS ON INTERCEPT AND SLOPE
      i~ Sex+Edu+Income+Locality+Family+Mstatus+CD4C+BDI+MMSE
      s1~ Sex+Edu+Income+Locality+Family+Mstatus+CD4C+BDI+MMSE
      s2~ Sex+Edu+Income+Locality+Family+Mstatus+CD4C+BDI+MMSE
               ' 
 
  fit.1<- growth(Model.1,data=CD4,missing="ml",bootstrap=100,se= "bootstrap")  #### small bootstrap sample to check.
  summary(fit.1, fit.measures=TRUE,rsq=TRUE)# FOR P-VALUES 

Selected  Results:
  
   Regressions:   Est.      S.E.     Z-value        p-value.
  i ~
    Sex               5.653    0.000
    Edu               4.219    0.000
    Income            0.579    0.000
    Locality         -0.631    0.000 -42551.447    0.000
    Family           -0.010    0.000 -748.203    0.000

    CD4C              1.053    0.000
    BDI              -0.007    0.000 -2433.211    0.000
    MMSE              0.185    0.000
  
    Any help is greatly appreciated.

I'm not sure which version of lavaan produced the zeroes, but the
current version (0.5-10) fails with the error:

Error in start[ov.int.idx] <-
sampl...@missing.h1[[g]]$mu[sample.int.idx] :
replacement has length zero

This is a bug (only triggered if 1) missing="ml", 2) the model contains
exogenous variables). Fixed now in the dev version (and the SE are not
zero anymore). You can install the dev version by typing in R:

install.packages("pbivnorm")
install.packages("lavaan", repos="http://www.da.ugent.be", type="source")


But there is another problem here: some of the predictors in your
regression are categorical, with more than two levels. Lavaan (unlike
lm())) does NOT automatically expand categorical predictors to a set of
dummy variables. You need to create dummy variables manually.

Yves.
